extraction_notes: Report is a Word (.docx) file (format 'docx'); no fixed pagination, so page is null. Where two samples are listed the 'Level Detected' equals their mean but the report does not label it an average, so value_basis is kept as 'level detected' and average is null. Table 4 contains a second 'Lead' row (source sample, 1.20 ppb) in addition to the Table 2 90th-percentile result (0.70 ppb); both are recorded with id 'lead'. Combined Radium PHG printed '(0)4'. Table 6 (unregulated contaminants) and Table 7 (violations) are 'None'. The report's Lead Service Line Inventory statement says the inventory was submitted by the October 16, 2025 deadline and found no lead service lines.
